title: Assured Identity Demo — node inventory
description: Installations participating in the demo. Gitignored in practice; demo-nodes.example.json documents it. Contains NO secrets — credentials live in deploy/keys.env.

id.description: Stable handle used by -IssuerNode/-SubscriberNode. Unique within the inventory.

role.description: Default/expected role; a node may be re-selected at run time.

gateway.description: API gateway base URL the toolkit calls.

installationName.description: The installation's JWT InstallationName. Documents the trust boundary.

rendezvousCapable.description: Whether this node accepts inbound reverse streams (public/rendezvous).

adminEmail.description: Sysadmin login on this node. Password comes from deploy/keys.env, never here.
